metadata.title: Aster model and design review plan

scope.content: The review plan examines whether the model and design actually explain Aster's boundary, interactions, data meaning, and evidence limits; it does not predeclare a pass.

fields.requirements_links: Cadence, latest-valid, boundary ownership, and no-fabricated-reading requirements provide the review basis.
fields.design_links: System-context, interaction-flow, data-model, and operation-contract documents are the artifacts under review.

questions.content: Reviewers ask whether each actor is correctly placed, every figure matches its named view, invariants are testable, and fictional content is distinguished from evidence.

fields.review_questions: Are boundary and exchange direction correct, do figures match model views and prose, are ownership and errors precise, and are limits honest?
fields.methods: Use model-to-document inspection, figure-to-SVG comparison, requirement-to-design tracing, and independent semantic judgment.

inputs.content: Reviewers receive exact model and document hashes, both SVGs, source records, and a checklist that separates structural findings from unresolved judgments.

fields.inputs: Example model, selected documents and figures, reviewed source list, artifact hashes, and the concern/omission coverage list.
fields.procedure: Inspect each concern, record evidence and disagreements, compare figure readings to visible geometry and model views, then issue a separate verdict.
fields.expected_results: Every concern has a documented judgment with findings or an explicit no-finding result and all residual limitations remain visible.

criteria.content: A pass is allowed only when the independent reviewer finds the scenario artifacts useful, technically coherent, traceable, and free of unaddressed fidelity defects.

fields.pass_criteria: No unresolved blocking semantic finding; every figure and model view agrees and every judgment identifies its authority and assessed hashes.
fields.trace_matrix: Boundary maps to context review, ordering to interaction review, meaning to data review, fidelity to SVG review, and evidence to hash review.

limits.content: The plan itself is not the review and supplies no independent verdict; originality and user comprehension require additional evidence beyond structure.

fields.unexecuted_cases: The independent review is planned until a named reviewer evaluates the identified artifact revision.
fields.residual_risks: A checklist cannot prove originality, user usefulness, or engineering correctness without the reviewer's actual judgment.
